topic: Asset data location and renaming plan
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the proper location for updating asset data, specifically renaming a network element (DOOH-1380). Initially, it was noted that the data resides in multiple locations. A proposed plan involves maintaining the data in two places for one month to compare discrepancies before fully migrating the source of truth to the facility dataset.

It was advised that all changes should be made within the assets section because most systems currently pull read data from there. The conversation concluded with a focus on gathering specific discrepancy points, such as installation dates.
decisions: Asset renaming (DOOH-1380) will be handled in the asset tables.
Data source for discrepancies will be monitored across two locations for one month before full migration to facility data.
action_items: Collect specific discrepancy points, such as installation dates, from various sources.
